body:
Done on branch cl13 (commit 5254879, not merged): launches now write themselves onto the board; no more hand edits of posts or _trains.

## What changed
- **`kit.py launch <post>`** (the line `step new` / the TaskCreate hook now give): refuses a prompt that is not committed; writes `status: in progress`, `session_id`, `launched_at`, `branch` on the post and marks its Trains row (and its train root) running.
  - CLI: `claude --bg -n board-<part>` inside a worktree made from the current branch (`.claude/worktrees/<part>`), never `claude -w` from main. An existing worktree with uncommitted work, or a branch with its own commits, is refused (`--reset` to restart).
  - Web: prints the `create_session` call (repo, current branch, outcome branch, prompt); `launch <post> --session-id <id>` records the real id.
- **Attached board from config**: `.kit/config.json` `kit.artifact = {url: your Artifact, prefix: repos/board/}`. `artifact pull/load/push/sent/pin` all use the prefix; `board_cli.py` names the Artifact when no local server answers; `kit_artifact_sync.py` docs/diffs default into repos/board/.
- **`kit.py resume`** flags `launched, died` (branch, worktree or transcript left, no live session) and lists what is uncommitted in the worktree.

## Tests
Red on main first: 9/9 failing. Green on cl13: 9/9. Two existing tests changed only their expected launch line (test_train_and_task_train, test_install), and test_artifact_mode now pins prefix "" (the kit repo itself is attached now).
handoff: Orchestrator: launch with `python3 -I .kit/kit.py launch <post>`. On the web it prints the create_session call; after it, `kit.py launch <post> --session-id <id>`, then make the ArtifactData batch call it prints (repos/board/posts, pinned). cl13 at 68a0637 already contains main and cl20: merge it after cl20.
not_checked: A real create_session call and a real claude --bg (both faked in the tests); `install.py --update` keeping kit.artifact in a re-rendered config (the code reuses the existing config, not run); the Harmonize page not rebuilt (no page change).
title: A launched part is always visible on the board, on the right base
verdict: One command, `kit.py launch <post>`, now writes the part onto the board (post in progress + its Trains row running) on the CLI and on the web, and the kit repo finds its board in your Artifact (repos/board/) from its config alone.
